text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A victory, Trainer.
It was a good race... I think."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I enjoyed it immensely, and I'm sure the folks back home would be thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Running at full power has left me with an extraordinary hunger, however.
choice_data_list: What a feast we have today!
Let's give it our all next time too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Running at full power has left me with an extraordinary hunger, however.
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all next time too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? A feast... Sukiyaki, sushi,
a full-course carrot dinner, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... No good, thinking about it
only made my hunger worse, and now I'm dizzy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I feel like I'm about to collapse...
Trainer, let us head for a meal at once!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course.
I give my all in every single race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't run with all your might and give it your all,
winning isn't any fun."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Now that our bellies are full, it's time to train again.
Let's go, Trainer."
